name: Glissa Sunslayer
oracle_text:
First strike, deathtouch
Whenever Glissa Sunslayer deals combat damage to a player, choose one —
• You draw a card and lose 1 life.
• Destroy target enchantment.
• Remove up to three counters from target permanent.
blocked_sentences: • Remove up to three counters from target permanent.

needs.what: a remove_counters mode that removes up to N counters in total from a target permanent, of any kinds and in any mix the controller chooses (e.g. two -1/-1 and one loyalty), with zero allowed
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_remove_counters reads a single `counter` kind (defaulting to +1/+1) and removes a fixed `amount` of that kind only; it has no 'any kind' option, no per-kind split chosen by the player, and no 'up to'. move_counters has all_kinds but moves rather than removes, and the remove_counters cost key is a cost, not an effect
